title: Gaussian CDF rotation quotient bound
statement: Let $t,y\in\mathbb R$ and let $0<\theta<1$. For the standard Gaussian distribution function $\Phi$ and density $\varphi$, $$\frac{\left|\Phi\left(\frac{t-\sin(\theta)y}{\cos(\theta)}\right)-\Phi(t)\right|}{\theta}\le 2\varphi(0)(|t|+|y|).$$
replaced: Let $\Phi,\varphi$ denote the standard Gaussian distribution function and density. For $t,y\in\mathbb R$, define $q_{t,y}(\theta)=\Phi((t-\sin\theta\,y)/\cos\theta)-\Phi(t)$. For all $t,y\in\mathbb R$ and $0<\theta<1$, $|q_{t,y}(\theta)|/\theta\le2\varphi(0)(|t|+|y|)$.
